correctness.rationale: Exact conditional moved-prefix law. Conditional suffix has a geometric comparison at q/(np^2). A factorial-moment inversion bounds the TV distance between partial-injection fixed counts and Poisson(t/m) by e^2/t. Conditional errors are O_c(1/n) outside an O_c(1/n) occupancy-tail event. The averaged Poisson–geometric family is twice differentiable in l1; its linear term is E[K/n-a]=O_c(1/n), and the quadratic remainder uses Var(K/n)=O(1/n), proving the stated O_c(1/n) bound. Finite checker reproduces 1,712 exact and numerical assertions; these do not constitute the infinite proof.
